jobs.title: VP Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering comprehensive virtual care solutions spanning virtual care including primary, mental health, expert medical, devices and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve their healthcare needs with confidence. Serving over 9 million Canadians, Teladoc Health has been in Canada for more than 20 years and operates in 175 countries world-wide.

Position Summary

The Vice President, Technology and Innovation (“VP”) is responsible for defining and executing Teladoc Health Canada’s technology, product, innovation and cybersecurity strategy. The VP leads the development and delivery of Teladoc Health Canada's digital products and technology ecosystem, including product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and analytics, technology operations, and innovation. The role is accountable for building a secure, reliable, scalable, and modern technology environment that enables high-quality virtual and hybrid care, an exceptional client, clinician, and patient experience, and operational excellence.

The VP provides executive leadership for Teladoc Health Canada's digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring technology investments and product capabilities align with Canadian market needs, regulatory requirements, enterprise priorities, and Teladoc Health's global strategy. Working closely with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, compliance, and global technology leaders, the VP plays a key role in advancing Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework and responsible use of data and AI, while delivering technology solutions that drive revenue growth, innovation, quality of care, security, and operational efficiency.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & Delivery

Develop and refresh Teladoc Health Canada’s digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with organizational strategy and business objectives;
Provide secure, scalable, resilient and sustainable digital solutions and technology infrastructure that meet Canadian business, market and regulatory requirements;
Lead the strategy, design, development, delivery, and lifecycle management of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem, including enterprise architecture, applications, integrations, infrastructure, and digital platforms;
Develop and execute Teladoc Health Canada’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring appropriate security controls, resilience, and cybersecurity risk management across technology platforms and information assets
Own the budget, portfolio, and project management of digital initiatives and ongoing technology operations, ensuring disciplined prioritization, resource allocation, and value delivery; and
Develop and manage strategic relationships with technology partners and vendors.

Product Strategy & Delivery

Lead Teladoc Canada’s multi-year product roadmap to enable operational excellence, high-quality clinical care, commercial growth, and exceptional client, clinician and patient experiences;
Translate market, regulatory, clinical, and operational requirements into innovative digital products;
Champion user-centred design by incorporating the perspectives of clients, clinicians, patients, and internal users throughout the product lifecycle to deliver intuitive, accessible, and seamless digital experiences; and
Integrate customer feedback, clinical insights, analytics, and user research into product planning, development and continuous improvement.

Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

Lead the operational implementation of Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework, including data architecture, stewardship, quality, metadata, lifecycle management, and data governance technologies, in partnership with the legal, privacy and compliance teams, and business stakeholders.
Champion enterprise analytics, business intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that support operational excellence, clinical quality, innovation, and informed business decision-making.
Develop and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable data management capabilities that enable high-quality clinical insights, operational intelligence, performance measurement, forecasting, and the responsible use of AI.
Oversee enterprise data and analytics for the Canadian business, delivering timely, accurate, and actionable insights that support strategic planning, operational performance, and continuous improvement.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

Partner with legal, privacy and compliance teams to ensure technology solutions meet applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, security, and clinical quality requirements, relevant market standards and clinical-quality expectations (e.g., PHIPA, PIPEDA, provincial health and privacy regulations, virtual care standards, responsible AI practices);
Establish and oversee technology governance, including enterprise architecture, software development lifecycle (SDLC), cybersecurity, and cloud governance frameworks and processes, while partnering with the legal, privacy and compliance teams on enterprise data and AI governance and technology vendor risk management; and
Identify, assess, and manage technology and cybersecurity risks by implementing appropriate controls, monitoring, and mitigation strategies to support the organization’s enterprise risk management framework, business resilience, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements.

Technology Operations & Cybersecurity

Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure IT operations that support business continuity, organizational growth, and compliance with applicable organizational, contractual, and regulatory requirements;
Oversee the performance, availability, and reliability of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem through proactive monitoring, incident management, issue triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent recurrence and improve system resilience;
Provide executive oversight of Teladoc Health Canada's cybersecurity program, including information security operations, vulnerability management, identity and access management, incident response, disaster recovery, business continuity, and continuous enhancement of security controls.
Lead technology support services for clinicians, clients, and internal users, while coordinating with Global/International teams on shared platforms, infrastructure, devices (e.g., HHS, GSD), escalation management, and operational support.

People, Culture & Capability Building

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary technology organization;
Strengthen organizational capabilities across product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and AI, cloud and infrastructure, and technology operations;
Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, security-by-design, and user-centred product development.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Yes

Salary Range

$230,000 to $250,000/year

Position Type

Backfill

Qualifications Expected For Position

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Health Informatics, Business or related field (advanced degree preferred);
12+ years of progressive senior leadership experience in technology, product management, digital transformation, and/or data and analytics, within healthcare, virtual/hybrid care, or a highly regulated sector;
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute technology strategies that align with organizational objectives and deliver measurable business outcomes;
Deep understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, data and analytics, AI, and emerging technology trends;
Demonstrated experience leading technology modernization, digital transformation, and enterprise technology operations;
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, and compliance functions, and global counterparts;
Demonstrated success leading multi-disciplinary, distributed, and high-performing teams within a complex, multinational corporate structure; and
Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities, with a proven track record of managing technology portfolios, product roadmaps, budgets, vendors, and delivery outcomes.

Work Environment

☐ Office ☐ Remote ☒ Hybrid (Office & Remote)

Travel: up to 10%

Travel percentage reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

Physical Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Teladoc Health will make reasonable accommodations for the known

physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual in line with company policy.

Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering the only comprehensive virtual care solution spanning telehealth, expert medical, and licensed platform services. jobs.title: VP Enterprise Marketing
jobs.description:
Mentimeter is an engagement company with a simple goal: to make every leader better. Through interaction, insights and recommendations, its platform helps organizations turn participation into better understanding and stronger performance.

Founded in Stockholm in 2012, Mentimeter is used by 20 million people each month across 1.3 million organizations. At Mentimeter, we believe better leadership starts with listening and that the strongest results are achieved together. That’s why we foster a culture built on curiosity, collaboration and shared ownership. By joining us, you’ll help leaders turn participation into deeper understanding and stronger performance, advancing our ambition to help more than one billion people listen, learn and work better together.

Build Mentimeter's enterprise growth engine

40 million users have experienced the value of using a Menti!

Building on that product-led foundation, Mentimeter is used daily by more than 84.000 organisations globally across all industries and we now serve more than 3,200 Enterprise customers globally. Our next challenge is to increase a systematic enterprise demand growth engine - and we are looking for a VP Enterprise Marketing to lead that journey.

This is a global leadership role responsible for how Mentimeter creates, identifies and converts enterprise demand. You will lead our Enterprise Marketing organisation, report to our Chief Sales Officer and join Mentimeter's Global Enterprise Leadership Team. Your primary focus will be EMEA and North America, while building the foundations for APAC. The goal is to connect our product adoption, organic reach and customer base into an Enterprise qualified pipeline, ARR and customer growth.

What You'll Lead

You will lead three existing teams, each with an experienced leader, across three connected areas:

Digital demand

Build and optimize enterprise demand generation and capture across web, paid media, account-based programs, content distribution, conversion and nurture.

Field and customer marketing

Develop a global strategy across events, partner programs, customer advocacy, regional activation and use-case storytelling - measured by account engagement, adoption, pipeline and expansion, not simply attendance.

Executive Exchange

Build Mentimeter's Executive Exchange into a distinctive platform for strategic customers, including our Enterprise Community, executive networks, education and certification programs.

What You'll Own

Define and own Mentimeter's global Enterprise Marketing strategy, budget and operating model.
Build an integrated system for demand generation and demand capture that turns our PLG footprint and product signals into account-level pipeline.
Set priorities across segments, accounts, audiences, buying groups, use cases and regions, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
Create qualified pipeline and measurable Enterprise ARR impact, with clear accountability for conversion, velocity, attribution and ROI.
Recruit, coach and develop leaders and senior marketing talent, creating an organisation that performs beyond your direct involvement.
Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Growth, Brand, Data and regional leadership to strengthen the handover from product-led growth to sales-assisted opportunities.
Stop, redesign or reallocate investment away from programs that do not create meaningful customer or commercial impact.

What Will Help You Succeed

You are an experienced B2B marketing leader who combines strategic range with commercial discipline. You are likely to bring:

12+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including significant leadership experience in Enterprise Marketing, Demand Generation, Integrated Marketing or a closely related area.
Experience leading leaders and multidisciplinary teams across digital demand, field marketing, customer marketing or executive programs.
A strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys, account-based marketing, buying groups, demand capture and pipeline creation in a PLG environment.
Experience connecting product-led or high-volume inbound growth with a sales-assisted enterprise motion.
Commercial fluency across funnel economics, pipeline, conversion, attribution, investment and ROI.
Experience operating across EMEA and/or North America and adapting global programs to local markets.
An AI-native approach to marketing: using AI to improve insight, experimentation, personalisation and performance - not only individual productivity.

The Kind Of Leader Who Will Thrive Here

You create clarity where ownership is shared and the answer is not obvious. You set a high bar while building trust, develop leaders and give talented people meaningful ownership. Most importantly, you want to build - not simply inherit and administer - a modern Enterprise Marketing function, see the strategy through and be accountable for its long-term impact. You are ambitious while staying humble, curious and collaborative in how you get there.

Why this role

You will have the mandate to shape how Mentimeter approaches enterprise demand globally and define the next chapter of our Enterprise growth. If you are looking for a finished playbook, this probably is not the role for you. If you want to build the system and be accountable for its impact, we would like to hear from you.

We’re actively hiring for one position, which can be based in either Stockholm or Toronto. The role follows our hybrid way of working.

How We Lead At Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we have a Leadership Manifesto that sets a shared direction for how we lead ourselves, our teams and the business. We call it Heart & Bravery.

It starts with authenticity: knowing yourself, showing yourself and leading yourself.

We expect our leaders to develop high-performing teams through both care and challenge, drive the right results in a changing environment, and set a clear direction by connecting the work to our vision and making the complex simple.

You will learn more about our Leadership Manifesto throughout the recruitment process. These principles are also an important part of how we assess and hire leaders at Mentimeter.

Our recruitment process

We Want The Process To Be Transparent And Give Both You And Us The Opportunity To Get To Know Each Other Properly. The Steps Are

TA Intro Interview
Hiring Manager Interview: A 20-minute digital chat with our Chief Sales Officer to meet and learn more about the role
Business Case & Competence Interview
A short business case, submitted the day before the competence interview
Competence interview: 75-minute at our office

Leadership and culture interview: 90-minute at our office
References and a coffee chat with the team
Offer and signing

Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The annual base salary range for this role is $226,000–$303,000 CAD. It’s intentionally broad to reflect different stages of growth within the role: from growing into its full scope to bringing deep expertise and meaningful impact from day one.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your compensation will be reviewed as your skills, scope and impact evolve.

In addition to your salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package - learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/toronto .

What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people. AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.

Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

jobs.title: Director Analytics Engineering
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As Director, Analytics Engineering, you’ll lead the roadmap, architecture, and team responsible for the trusted data foundations that power 1Password’s business. You’ll shape how data is modeled, tested, documented, governed, and made available to teams across Marketing, Finance, Product, Analytics, and Data Engineering, while staying close to the technical work when it matters. By building reliable data foundations for Artificial Intelligence (AI), you’ll help advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future. Reporting to the VP, Data Analytics, this role is remote within the United States and Canada.

How We’re Using AI Today

On the Finance team, we’re using AI to drive productivity, scale insight, and deliver better decision-making across 1Password. AI helps us move faster and sharpen our thinking, from summarizing context and pressure-testing assumptions to turning complex inputs into clear executive-level narratives. We bring AI into our work thoughtfully, improving repeatable workflows while staying accountable for the accuracy, confidentiality, and controls behind every output, creating space to focus on judgement, strategic partnership, and meaningful business outcomes.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

Significant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including experience leading and developing teams.
Strong Structured Query Language (SQL) and dbt experience, including advanced data modeling, incremental processing, testing, documentation, and multi-environment deployment.
Deep knowledge of dimensional modeling, such as Kimball or star schema approaches, applied in complex Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environments.
Experience with modern cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift, including decisions related to performance, cost, and scale.
Experience establishing semantic layer strategies and trusted metric definitions across an organization.
Ability to translate complex business priorities into a clear data platform roadmap and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect, and AI-assisted analytics engineering workflows.

What You Can Expect

Own the vision, roadmap, and execution for 1Password’s analytics engineering function, including core data models, semantic layers, Business Intelligence (BI) tooling, and pipeline infrastructure.
Hire, manage, and develop analytics engineers while establishing clear career ladders, leveling expectations, and performance practices.
Set standards for data modeling, testing, documentation, code review, deployment, and data quality.
Stay close to the technical work by reviewing complex dbt models, optimizing SQL, and helping troubleshoot high-priority pipeline issues.
Serve as a senior technical partner on data modeling and metric governance, ensuring definitions are consistent, trusted, and well documented.
Partner with leaders across Data Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Marketing, Product, and Go To Market (GTM) teams to turn business needs into a prioritized roadmap.
Build governed, reliable data foundations that support company-wide decision-making, AI initiatives, and Generative BI experiences.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $204,000 USD and $306,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $200,000 CAD and $300,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

jobs.title: Head of Digital Product & Experience, Tim Hortons, Canada
jobs.description:
Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

The Head of Digital Product & Experience is responsible for leading Product, Design, and Product Analytics for Tim Hortons’ owned digital guest experiences across Mobile App, Web, Catering, and connected delivery experiences, including product capabilities that leverage AI/ML for personalization, optimization, and improved guest experiences.

This leader oversees product and experience teams aligned to core digital commerce and engagement capabilities while partnering closely with Engineering, Restaurant Technology, Marketing, Loyalty/CRM, Operations, and Support to deliver scalable, modern, and high-performing digital experiences.

The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise, strong product operating discipline, design fluency, analytical rigor, technical fluency, and modern AI-enabled product development practices. This role requires a leader who can create clarity across complex cross-functional environments, translate strategy into disciplined product execution, and drive measurable guest and business outcomes through strong prioritization, product discovery, experience direction, analytics, and roadmap ownership.

This role is best suited for a high-ownership leader who thrives in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. The successful candidate will bring urgency, resilience, and a strong bias for action, while leading with curiosity, humility, and respect for existing context. They should be able to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, build trust across teams, and help shape, hire, and develop the Product and Experience organization as it scales.

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for shaping the future of one of Canada’s largest and most engaged digital restaurant ecosystems.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Roadmap & Prioritization

Define and evolve the product vision, strategic roadmap, and prioritization framework across Tim Hortons’ owned digital experiences.
Lead product investment decisions across multiple domains, balancing guest experience, business priorities, operational realities, analytics, and technical scalability.
Translate guest insights, analytics, operational feedback, and market trends into clear product strategies and actionable roadmaps.
Ensure digital product investments align to long-term platform evolution and measurable business outcomes.
Own product discovery, problem definition, requirements clarity, and success metrics so initiatives are well-defined, validated, prioritized, and ready for effective cross-functional execution.
Partner with Engineering to understand platform health, technical dependencies, and infrastructure investments that impact product capability, delivery velocity, reliability, or guest experience, ensuring these tradeoffs are reflected in roadmap and prioritization discussions.

Product, Experience & Analytics Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop teams across Product, Design, and Product Analytics, ensuring these capabilities operate as an integrated Product and Experience organization.
Build clear accountability, strong business judgment, customer obsession, and consistent product standards across the team.
Bring a clear point of view on team structure, role design, and hiring priorities to support stronger execution, clearer ownership, and long-term scalability.
Coach and develop product and experience talent, strengthening craft, ownership, and disciplined execution.
Lean in directly where needed to support product strategy, experience direction, analytics interpretation, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, or cross-functional decision-making.

Product Execution, Guest Experience & Measurement

Own product-side execution from strategy through launch and optimization, ensuring initiatives are clearly defined, prioritized, designed, measured, and ready for effective delivery.
Lead cohesive digital guest experiences across app, web, catering, delivery, restaurant-connected journeys, and other digital touchpoints.
Ensure Product and Design decisions are grounded in guest insights, business context, analytics, operational realities, and clear success metrics.
Advance design craft, consistency, and execution quality across guest-facing digital experiences.
Bring Product Analytics closer to product strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and performance management so decisions are grounded in guest behavior, funnel performance, and measurable outcomes.
Own measurable digital product outcomes including engagement, conversion, ordering performance, payment performance, loyalty engagement, adoption, retention, guest satisfaction, and digital sales contribution.

AI-Enabled Product & Engineering Partnership

Partner closely with Engineering and data/ML teams to translate AI/ML-enabled opportunities into scalable product capabilities and measurable guest or business impact.
Champion modern product management practices including experimentation, rapid iteration, AI-assisted workflows, and data-informed decision making.
Support build-versus-buy evaluations for AI-enabled product tools, personalization platforms, experimentation capabilities, and digital experience workflows.
Partner with Engineering on solution shaping, feasibility, planning, quality, and release readiness, while maintaining clear accountability for product outcomes and guest experience.
Ensure Product, Design, and Analytics provide the clarity, inputs, and decision-making needed to support efficient, high-quality cross-functional delivery.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Performance

Collaborate with Restaurant Technology, Marketing, Loyalty/CRM, Operations, Support, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to align digital product decisions with business goals and operational realities.
Drive alignment across complex cross-functional initiatives while ensuring Product brings clarity to problem definition, prioritization, customer outcomes, requirements, experience direction, success metrics, and launch readiness.
Ensure product and experience decisions balance guest value, business impact, operational feasibility, scalability, technical sustainability, and restaurant owner impact.
Create communication routines that provide visibility into roadmap progress, tradeoffs, risks, and performance outcomes.
Build trust across the Product and Experience organization and with cross-functional partners through curiosity, transparency, follow-through, and respect for existing context.

Qualifications

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Analytics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in Product Management, Digital Product, Digital Experience, Product Strategy, or Technology Strategy roles.

The Senior Director, Infrastructure Compliance & Automation is responsible for leading enterprise Infrastructure compliance, vulnerability remediation enablement, automation, and emerging infrastructure automation technologies.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership across infrastructure controls, regulatory and audit compliance, vulnerability remediation, patching automation, and infrastructure automation platforms. The Senior Director partners closely with Cyber Security, Internal Audit, External Audit, Infrastructure Engineering and Operations teams, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and other technology organizations to ensure enterprise infrastructure services operate in accordance with established security, compliance, and control requirements.

The role leads the Infrastructure organization's response to evolving vulnerability management and patching requirements, with a focus on increasing automation, improving remediation velocity, reducing operational risk, and enabling consistent execution across the infrastructure environment.

The Senior Director also leads Infrastructure compliance activities supporting SOX, SOC 1, SOC 2, and other applicable enterprise controls and audits, ensuring controls are effectively implemented, evidence is complete and timely, deficiencies are remediated, and Infrastructure teams remain audit-ready.

In addition, this leader owns the Infrastructure automation strategy and capabilities, including Ansible and emerging AI-enabled infrastructure platforms, with responsibility for expanding automation across provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, lifecycle management, and infrastructure operations

Key Responsibilities:

Infrastructure Compliance & Controls:

Lead Infrastructure compliance and controls activities across enterprise compute, storage, backup, database, operating system, virtualization, data center, and related infrastructure services.
Ensure Infrastructure teams effectively implement and maintain required enterprise security, operational, and regulatory controls.
Lead Infrastructure activities supporting SOX, SOC 1, SOC 2, and other internal and external audits.
Establish processes to ensure control evidence is accurate, complete, timely, and consistently maintained.
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Cyber Security, Risk, and Infrastructure leadership throughout control assessments and audits.
Coordinate remediation of Infrastructure control deficiencies, audit findings, and identified compliance gaps.
Translate new or changing enterprise controls into actionable Infrastructure requirements and ensure successful implementation across impacted technology teams.
Establish reporting and governance mechanisms that provide leadership visibility into Infrastructure compliance posture, control effectiveness, audit readiness, and remediation activities.
Promote continuous audit readiness rather than point-in-time preparation for individual audits.

Vulnerability & Patch Management Enablement:

Lead Infrastructure vulnerability remediation enablement in partnership with Cyber Security, Infrastructure Engineering and Operations teams, and MSP partners.
Establish prioritization, and escalation processes supporting timely remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities.
Drive remediation of operating system, platform, and third-party software vulnerabilities across the enterprise infrastructure environment.
Partner with Cyber Security to translate vulnerability management requirements into actionable Infrastructure remediation priorities.
Drive increased automation of patch deployment and vulnerability remediation across supported infrastructure platforms.
Partner with MSP providers responsible for operational patching activities to ensure execution aligns with enterprise security requirements, service-level expectations, and remediation timelines.
Identify systemic barriers to vulnerability remediation and work across Engineering, Operations, Cyber Security, application teams, and technology partners to resolve them.
Establish metrics and executive reporting for vulnerability backlog, remediation performance, patch compliance, exceptions, aging, and risk.
Drive continuous improvement in patching coverage, remediation velocity, automation, and operational effectiveness.

Infrastructure Automation:

Define and lead the Infrastructure automation strategy and roadmap.
Own and advance enterprise Infrastructure automation capabilities, including Ansible Automation Platform and related automation technologies.
Expand automation across server provisioning, configuration management, patching, compliance, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, infrastructure operations, and service management processes.
Partner with Infrastructure Engineering teams to identify high-value automation opportunities that improve reliability, security, speed, and operational efficiency.
Establish automation standards, reusable capabilities, governance, and engineering practices that enable consistent adoption across Infrastructure.
Reduce manual operational activities and improve service delivery through automation and orchestration.
Establish metrics demonstrating automation adoption, operational efficiencies, risk reduction, and measurable business outcomes.

AI & Emerging Infrastructure Automation:

Evaluate emerging AI-enabled infrastructure management and automation capabilities applicable to enterprise Infrastructure.
Develop the roadmap for responsible adoption of AI capabilities that improve infrastructure operations, automation, compliance, vulnerability remediation, and service reliability.
Partner with enterprise architecture, Cyber Security, Cloud, Data and AI teams, and other technology organizations to ensure emerging Infrastructure AI capabilities align with enterprise standards and governance.
Identify practical use cases where AI and intelligent automation can reduce manual effort, accelerate issue identification and remediation, and improve operational decision-making.
Ensure emerging automation capabilities are introduced with appropriate security, controls, governance, and operational oversight.

Leadership & Organizational Development:

Build and lead a high-performing organization responsible for Infrastructure compliance, controls, vulnerability remediation enablement, and automation.
Establish clear accountability, priorities, performance expectations, and career development opportunities for team members.
Develop technical and leadership capabilities across the organization.
Promote a culture of accountability, automation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and risk awareness.

Minimum Job Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):

Education/Training –

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree or professional certifications in related areas preferred.

Specialized Knowledge/Skills –

10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise Infrastructure, technology operations, automation, cyber security, risk, compliance, or related disciplines.
Strong understanding of enterprise Infrastructure technologies including compute, operating systems, storage, backup, databases, virtualization, data centers, cloud infrastructure, and related technology services.
Experience leading teams responsible for infrastructure operations, automation, compliance, controls, vulnerability management, or related technology capabilities.
Demonstrated experience supporting SOX, SOC, internal audit, external audit, or comparable technology control environments.
Experience with enterprise vulnerability and patch management programs.
Experience operating in an outsourced or managed services environment and holding service providers accountable for operational outcomes.
Experience with enterprise automation platforms such as Ansible Automation Platform and related orchestration technologies.
Understanding of emerging AI and intelligent automation capabilities applicable to Infrastructure operations.
Strong analytical, executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong knowledge of ITIL / IT Service Management practices (incident, problem, change, service level management).

new_jobs.title: VP Enterprise Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Mentimeter is an engagement company with a simple goal: to make every leader better. Through interaction, insights and recommendations, its platform helps organizations turn participation into better understanding and stronger performance.

Founded in Stockholm in 2012, Mentimeter is used by 20 million people each month across 1.3 million organizations. At Mentimeter, we believe better leadership starts with listening and that the strongest results are achieved together. That’s why we foster a culture built on curiosity, collaboration and shared ownership. By joining us, you’ll help leaders turn participation into deeper understanding and stronger performance, advancing our ambition to help more than one billion people listen, learn and work better together.

Build Mentimeter's enterprise growth engine

40 million users have experienced the value of using a Menti!

Building on that product-led foundation, Mentimeter is used daily by more than 84.000 organisations globally across all industries and we now serve more than 3,200 Enterprise customers globally. Our next challenge is to increase a systematic enterprise demand growth engine - and we are looking for a VP Enterprise Marketing to lead that journey.

This is a global leadership role responsible for how Mentimeter creates, identifies and converts enterprise demand. You will lead our Enterprise Marketing organisation, report to our Chief Sales Officer and join Mentimeter's Global Enterprise Leadership Team. Your primary focus will be EMEA and North America, while building the foundations for APAC. The goal is to connect our product adoption, organic reach and customer base into an Enterprise qualified pipeline, ARR and customer growth.

What You'll Lead

You will lead three existing teams, each with an experienced leader, across three connected areas:

Digital demand

Build and optimize enterprise demand generation and capture across web, paid media, account-based programs, content distribution, conversion and nurture.

Field and customer marketing

Develop a global strategy across events, partner programs, customer advocacy, regional activation and use-case storytelling - measured by account engagement, adoption, pipeline and expansion, not simply attendance.

Executive Exchange

Build Mentimeter's Executive Exchange into a distinctive platform for strategic customers, including our Enterprise Community, executive networks, education and certification programs.

What You'll Own

Define and own Mentimeter's global Enterprise Marketing strategy, budget and operating model.
Build an integrated system for demand generation and demand capture that turns our PLG footprint and product signals into account-level pipeline.
Set priorities across segments, accounts, audiences, buying groups, use cases and regions, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
Create qualified pipeline and measurable Enterprise ARR impact, with clear accountability for conversion, velocity, attribution and ROI.
Recruit, coach and develop leaders and senior marketing talent, creating an organisation that performs beyond your direct involvement.
Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Growth, Brand, Data and regional leadership to strengthen the handover from product-led growth to sales-assisted opportunities.
Stop, redesign or reallocate investment away from programs that do not create meaningful customer or commercial impact.

What Will Help You Succeed

You are an experienced B2B marketing leader who combines strategic range with commercial discipline. You are likely to bring:

12+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including significant leadership experience in Enterprise Marketing, Demand Generation, Integrated Marketing or a closely related area.
Experience leading leaders and multidisciplinary teams across digital demand, field marketing, customer marketing or executive programs.
A strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys, account-based marketing, buying groups, demand capture and pipeline creation in a PLG environment.
Experience connecting product-led or high-volume inbound growth with a sales-assisted enterprise motion.
Commercial fluency across funnel economics, pipeline, conversion, attribution, investment and ROI.
Experience operating across EMEA and/or North America and adapting global programs to local markets.
An AI-native approach to marketing: using AI to improve insight, experimentation, personalisation and performance - not only individual productivity.

The Kind Of Leader Who Will Thrive Here

You create clarity where ownership is shared and the answer is not obvious. You set a high bar while building trust, develop leaders and give talented people meaningful ownership. Most importantly, you want to build - not simply inherit and administer - a modern Enterprise Marketing function, see the strategy through and be accountable for its long-term impact. You are ambitious while staying humble, curious and collaborative in how you get there.

Why this role

You will have the mandate to shape how Mentimeter approaches enterprise demand globally and define the next chapter of our Enterprise growth. If you are looking for a finished playbook, this probably is not the role for you. If you want to build the system and be accountable for its impact, we would like to hear from you.

We’re actively hiring for one position, which can be based in either Stockholm or Toronto. The role follows our hybrid way of working.

How We Lead At Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we have a Leadership Manifesto that sets a shared direction for how we lead ourselves, our teams and the business. We call it Heart & Bravery.

It starts with authenticity: knowing yourself, showing yourself and leading yourself.

We expect our leaders to develop high-performing teams through both care and challenge, drive the right results in a changing environment, and set a clear direction by connecting the work to our vision and making the complex simple.

You will learn more about our Leadership Manifesto throughout the recruitment process. These principles are also an important part of how we assess and hire leaders at Mentimeter.

Our recruitment process

We Want The Process To Be Transparent And Give Both You And Us The Opportunity To Get To Know Each Other Properly. The Steps Are

TA Intro Interview
Hiring Manager Interview: A 20-minute digital chat with our Chief Sales Officer to meet and learn more about the role
Business Case & Competence Interview
A short business case, submitted the day before the competence interview
Competence interview: 75-minute at our office

Leadership and culture interview: 90-minute at our office
References and a coffee chat with the team
Offer and signing

Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The annual base salary range for this role is $226,000–$303,000 CAD. It’s intentionally broad to reflect different stages of growth within the role: from growing into its full scope to bringing deep expertise and meaningful impact from day one.

new_jobs.title: Director Analytics Engineering
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As Director, Analytics Engineering, you’ll lead the roadmap, architecture, and team responsible for the trusted data foundations that power 1Password’s business. You’ll shape how data is modeled, tested, documented, governed, and made available to teams across Marketing, Finance, Product, Analytics, and Data Engineering, while staying close to the technical work when it matters. By building reliable data foundations for Artificial Intelligence (AI), you’ll help advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future. Reporting to the VP, Data Analytics, this role is remote within the United States and Canada.

How We’re Using AI Today

On the Finance team, we’re using AI to drive productivity, scale insight, and deliver better decision-making across 1Password. AI helps us move faster and sharpen our thinking, from summarizing context and pressure-testing assumptions to turning complex inputs into clear executive-level narratives. We bring AI into our work thoughtfully, improving repeatable workflows while staying accountable for the accuracy, confidentiality, and controls behind every output, creating space to focus on judgement, strategic partnership, and meaningful business outcomes.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

Significant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including experience leading and developing teams.
Strong Structured Query Language (SQL) and dbt experience, including advanced data modeling, incremental processing, testing, documentation, and multi-environment deployment.
Deep knowledge of dimensional modeling, such as Kimball or star schema approaches, applied in complex Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environments.
Experience with modern cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift, including decisions related to performance, cost, and scale.
Experience establishing semantic layer strategies and trusted metric definitions across an organization.
Ability to translate complex business priorities into a clear data platform roadmap and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect, and AI-assisted analytics engineering workflows.

What You Can Expect

Own the vision, roadmap, and execution for 1Password’s analytics engineering function, including core data models, semantic layers, Business Intelligence (BI) tooling, and pipeline infrastructure.
Hire, manage, and develop analytics engineers while establishing clear career ladders, leveling expectations, and performance practices.
Set standards for data modeling, testing, documentation, code review, deployment, and data quality.
Stay close to the technical work by reviewing complex dbt models, optimizing SQL, and helping troubleshoot high-priority pipeline issues.
Serve as a senior technical partner on data modeling and metric governance, ensuring definitions are consistent, trusted, and well documented.
Partner with leaders across Data Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Marketing, Product, and Go To Market (GTM) teams to turn business needs into a prioritized roadmap.
Build governed, reliable data foundations that support company-wide decision-making, AI initiatives, and Generative BI experiences.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $204,000 USD and $306,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $200,000 CAD and $300,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

new_jobs.description:
Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

The Head of Digital Product & Experience is responsible for leading Product, Design, and Product Analytics for Tim Hortons’ owned digital guest experiences across Mobile App, Web, Catering, and connected delivery experiences, including product capabilities that leverage AI/ML for personalization, optimization, and improved guest experiences.

This leader oversees product and experience teams aligned to core digital commerce and engagement capabilities while partnering closely with Engineering, Restaurant Technology, Marketing, Loyalty/CRM, Operations, and Support to deliver scalable, modern, and high-performing digital experiences.

The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise, strong product operating discipline, design fluency, analytical rigor, technical fluency, and modern AI-enabled product development practices. This role requires a leader who can create clarity across complex cross-functional environments, translate strategy into disciplined product execution, and drive measurable guest and business outcomes through strong prioritization, product discovery, experience direction, analytics, and roadmap ownership.

This role is best suited for a high-ownership leader who thrives in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. The successful candidate will bring urgency, resilience, and a strong bias for action, while leading with curiosity, humility, and respect for existing context. They should be able to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, build trust across teams, and help shape, hire, and develop the Product and Experience organization as it scales.

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for shaping the future of one of Canada’s largest and most engaged digital restaurant ecosystems.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Roadmap & Prioritization

Define and evolve the product vision, strategic roadmap, and prioritization framework across Tim Hortons’ owned digital experiences.
Lead product investment decisions across multiple domains, balancing guest experience, business priorities, operational realities, analytics, and technical scalability.
Translate guest insights, analytics, operational feedback, and market trends into clear product strategies and actionable roadmaps.
Ensure digital product investments align to long-term platform evolution and measurable business outcomes.
Own product discovery, problem definition, requirements clarity, and success metrics so initiatives are well-defined, validated, prioritized, and ready for effective cross-functional execution.
Partner with Engineering to understand platform health, technical dependencies, and infrastructure investments that impact product capability, delivery velocity, reliability, or guest experience, ensuring these tradeoffs are reflected in roadmap and prioritization discussions.

Product, Experience & Analytics Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop teams across Product, Design, and Product Analytics, ensuring these capabilities operate as an integrated Product and Experience organization.
Build clear accountability, strong business judgment, customer obsession, and consistent product standards across the team.
Bring a clear point of view on team structure, role design, and hiring priorities to support stronger execution, clearer ownership, and long-term scalability.
Coach and develop product and experience talent, strengthening craft, ownership, and disciplined execution.
Lean in directly where needed to support product strategy, experience direction, analytics interpretation, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, or cross-functional decision-making.

Product Execution, Guest Experience & Measurement

Own product-side execution from strategy through launch and optimization, ensuring initiatives are clearly defined, prioritized, designed, measured, and ready for effective delivery.
Lead cohesive digital guest experiences across app, web, catering, delivery, restaurant-connected journeys, and other digital touchpoints.
Ensure Product and Design decisions are grounded in guest insights, business context, analytics, operational realities, and clear success metrics.
Advance design craft, consistency, and execution quality across guest-facing digital experiences.
Bring Product Analytics closer to product strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and performance management so decisions are grounded in guest behavior, funnel performance, and measurable outcomes.
Own measurable digital product outcomes including engagement, conversion, ordering performance, payment performance, loyalty engagement, adoption, retention, guest satisfaction, and digital sales contribution.

AI-Enabled Product & Engineering Partnership

Partner closely with Engineering and data/ML teams to translate AI/ML-enabled opportunities into scalable product capabilities and measurable guest or business impact.
Champion modern product management practices including experimentation, rapid iteration, AI-assisted workflows, and data-informed decision making.
Support build-versus-buy evaluations for AI-enabled product tools, personalization platforms, experimentation capabilities, and digital experience workflows.
Partner with Engineering on solution shaping, feasibility, planning, quality, and release readiness, while maintaining clear accountability for product outcomes and guest experience.
Ensure Product, Design, and Analytics provide the clarity, inputs, and decision-making needed to support efficient, high-quality cross-functional delivery.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Performance

Collaborate with Restaurant Technology, Marketing, Loyalty/CRM, Operations, Support, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to align digital product decisions with business goals and operational realities.
Drive alignment across complex cross-functional initiatives while ensuring Product brings clarity to problem definition, prioritization, customer outcomes, requirements, experience direction, success metrics, and launch readiness.
Ensure product and experience decisions balance guest value, business impact, operational feasibility, scalability, technical sustainability, and restaurant owner impact.
Create communication routines that provide visibility into roadmap progress, tradeoffs, risks, and performance outcomes.
Build trust across the Product and Experience organization and with cross-functional partners through curiosity, transparency, follow-through, and respect for existing context.

Qualifications

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Analytics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in Product Management, Digital Product, Digital Experience, Product Strategy, or Technology Strategy roles.
5+ years of experience leading product managers, design teams, product analytics teams, or cross-functional digital product organizations.
Proven track record leading consumer-facing mobile app, commerce, loyalty, ordering, marketplace, restaurant, retail, or digital ecosystem product teams.
Strong product management fundamentals including prioritization, roadmap management, discovery, experimentation, stakeholder alignment, requirements clarity, and agile delivery practices.
Strong design and analytical fluency, with the ability to evaluate guest experience strategy, UX quality, research inputs, funnel performance, experimentation, and product measurement.
Strong technical fluency and comfort partnering closely with Engineering organizations on platform capabilities, integrations, APIs, architecture considerations, data/ML capabilities, and technical tradeoffs.
Proven ability to establish product standards, coach talent, hire strong leaders, and improve execution across cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, scaling, or evolving environments.
Strong communication and organizational leadership skills with the ability to simplify complex problems for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Competencies

Experience leading large-scale mobile app, digital commerce, restaurant, retail, loyalty, delivery, marketplace, or omnichannel digital ecosystems.
Experience leading or closely partnering with Design, UX Research, Content Design, Product Analytics, or AI-enabled product functions.
Experience in franchise, QSR, retail, or other environments where digital product decisions have direct operational and commercial consequences for operators, as well as end consumers.
Experience balancing guest experience strategy with operational and business realities in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
Experience partnering with Engineering teams to improve planning quality, design readiness, analytics enablement, and delivery outcomes.

Leadership Characteristics

Guest-obsessed and operationally pragmatic
Product-led, experience-oriented, and analytically grounded
High-ownership leader with strong bias for action
Comfortable with pace, ambiguity, and high expectations
Hands-on when needed, while still building scalable teams, routines, and ownership
High standards with genuine humility
Builds trust through transparency, follow-through, and respect
Technically curious, AI-forward, and comfortable partnering deeply with Engineering
Strong communicator with high cross-functional credibility
Talent builder who can hire, coach, and develop teams effectively

RBI follows a 5 day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Successful candidates will be expected to work onsite 5 days per week.

This posting is for a position that will become vacant on or around July/August 2026.

Benefits at all of our global offices are focused on physical, mental and financial wellness. We offer unique and progressive benefits, including a comprehensive global paid parental leave program that supports employees as they expand their families, free telemedicine and mental wellness support.

The Senior Director, Infrastructure Compliance & Automation is responsible for leading enterprise Infrastructure compliance, vulnerability remediation enablement, automation, and emerging infrastructure automation technologies.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership across infrastructure controls, regulatory and audit compliance, vulnerability remediation, patching automation, and infrastructure automation platforms. The Senior Director partners closely with Cyber Security, Internal Audit, External Audit, Infrastructure Engineering and Operations teams, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and other technology organizations to ensure enterprise infrastructure services operate in accordance with established security, compliance, and control requirements.

The role leads the Infrastructure organization's response to evolving vulnerability management and patching requirements, with a focus on increasing automation, improving remediation velocity, reducing operational risk, and enabling consistent execution across the infrastructure environment.

The Senior Director also leads Infrastructure compliance activities supporting SOX, SOC 1, SOC 2, and other applicable enterprise controls and audits, ensuring controls are effectively implemented, evidence is complete and timely, deficiencies are remediated, and Infrastructure teams remain audit-ready.

In addition, this leader owns the Infrastructure automation strategy and capabilities, including Ansible and emerging AI-enabled infrastructure platforms, with responsibility for expanding automation across provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, lifecycle management, and infrastructure operations

Key Responsibilities:

Infrastructure Compliance & Controls:

Lead Infrastructure compliance and controls activities across enterprise compute, storage, backup, database, operating system, virtualization, data center, and related infrastructure services.
Ensure Infrastructure teams effectively implement and maintain required enterprise security, operational, and regulatory controls.
Lead Infrastructure activities supporting SOX, SOC 1, SOC 2, and other internal and external audits.
Establish processes to ensure control evidence is accurate, complete, timely, and consistently maintained.
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Cyber Security, Risk, and Infrastructure leadership throughout control assessments and audits.
Coordinate remediation of Infrastructure control deficiencies, audit findings, and identified compliance gaps.
Translate new or changing enterprise controls into actionable Infrastructure requirements and ensure successful implementation across impacted technology teams.
Establish reporting and governance mechanisms that provide leadership visibility into Infrastructure compliance posture, control effectiveness, audit readiness, and remediation activities.
Promote continuous audit readiness rather than point-in-time preparation for individual audits.

Vulnerability & Patch Management Enablement:

Lead Infrastructure vulnerability remediation enablement in partnership with Cyber Security, Infrastructure Engineering and Operations teams, and MSP partners.
Establish prioritization, and escalation processes supporting timely remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities.
Drive remediation of operating system, platform, and third-party software vulnerabilities across the enterprise infrastructure environment.
Partner with Cyber Security to translate vulnerability management requirements into actionable Infrastructure remediation priorities.
Drive increased automation of patch deployment and vulnerability remediation across supported infrastructure platforms.
Partner with MSP providers responsible for operational patching activities to ensure execution aligns with enterprise security requirements, service-level expectations, and remediation timelines.
Identify systemic barriers to vulnerability remediation and work across Engineering, Operations, Cyber Security, application teams, and technology partners to resolve them.
Establish metrics and executive reporting for vulnerability backlog, remediation performance, patch compliance, exceptions, aging, and risk.
Drive continuous improvement in patching coverage, remediation velocity, automation, and operational effectiveness.

Infrastructure Automation:

Define and lead the Infrastructure automation strategy and roadmap.
Own and advance enterprise Infrastructure automation capabilities, including Ansible Automation Platform and related automation technologies.
Expand automation across server provisioning, configuration management, patching, compliance, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, infrastructure operations, and service management processes.
Partner with Infrastructure Engineering teams to identify high-value automation opportunities that improve reliability, security, speed, and operational efficiency.
Establish automation standards, reusable capabilities, governance, and engineering practices that enable consistent adoption across Infrastructure.
Reduce manual operational activities and improve service delivery through automation and orchestration.
Establish metrics demonstrating automation adoption, operational efficiencies, risk reduction, and measurable business outcomes.

AI & Emerging Infrastructure Automation:

Evaluate emerging AI-enabled infrastructure management and automation capabilities applicable to enterprise Infrastructure.
Develop the roadmap for responsible adoption of AI capabilities that improve infrastructure operations, automation, compliance, vulnerability remediation, and service reliability.
Partner with enterprise architecture, Cyber Security, Cloud, Data and AI teams, and other technology organizations to ensure emerging Infrastructure AI capabilities align with enterprise standards and governance.
Identify practical use cases where AI and intelligent automation can reduce manual effort, accelerate issue identification and remediation, and improve operational decision-making.
Ensure emerging automation capabilities are introduced with appropriate security, controls, governance, and operational oversight.

Leadership & Organizational Development:

Build and lead a high-performing organization responsible for Infrastructure compliance, controls, vulnerability remediation enablement, and automation.
Establish clear accountability, priorities, performance expectations, and career development opportunities for team members.
Develop technical and leadership capabilities across the organization.
Promote a culture of accountability, automation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and risk awareness.

Minimum Job Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):

Education/Training –

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree or professional certifications in related areas preferred.

Specialized Knowledge/Skills –

10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise Infrastructure, technology operations, automation, cyber security, risk, compliance, or related disciplines.
Strong understanding of enterprise Infrastructure technologies including compute, operating systems, storage, backup, databases, virtualization, data centers, cloud infrastructure, and related technology services.
Experience leading teams responsible for infrastructure operations, automation, compliance, controls, vulnerability management, or related technology capabilities.
Demonstrated experience supporting SOX, SOC, internal audit, external audit, or comparable technology control environments.
Experience with enterprise vulnerability and patch management programs.
Experience operating in an outsourced or managed services environment and holding service providers accountable for operational outcomes.
Experience with enterprise automation platforms such as Ansible Automation Platform and related orchestration technologies.
Understanding of emerging AI and intelligent automation capabilities applicable to Infrastructure operations.
Strong analytical, executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong knowledge of ITIL / IT Service Management practices (incident, problem, change, service level management).
